title: Inherit4Rec: Parameter Inheritance for Efficient Scaling of Recommendation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23111v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling model capacity has emerged as an effective approach to overcoming performance bottlenecks in industrial recommender systems. However, repeatedly training larger dense models from scratch demands substantial data and time, while their growing computation conflicts with the strict serving budgets of industrial systems. Parameter inheritance provides a promising route for both dense model growth and sparse conversion, yet existing methods are primarily designed for static corpora and can suffer sharp performance drops under dynamically evolving recommendation data. To address these challenges, we propose Inherit4Rec, a parameter-inheritance framework that supports both Dense-to-Dense (D2D) growth and Dense-to-Sparse (D2S) conversion. Inherit4Rec-D2D combines hybrid growth with asymmetric training to preserve the forward function at expansion and maintain update continuity. translated_title: Inherit4Rec：面向推荐模型高效扩展的参数继承方法
translated_abstract: 扩展模型容量已成为克服工业推荐系统性能瓶颈的有效方法。然而，反复从零开始训练更大的稠密模型需要大量的数据和时间，而其不断增长的计算开销与工业系统严格的线上服务预算相冲突。参数继承为稠密模型的增长和稀疏化转换提供了一条有前景的路径，但现有方法主要面向静态语料库设计，在动态演化的推荐数据下可能出现剧烈的性能下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Inherit4Rec，一个同时支持稠密到稠密（D2D）增长和稠密到稀疏（D2S）转换的参数继承框架。Inherit4Rec-D2D将混合增长与非对称训练相结合，在模型扩展时保持前向函数的稳定性并维持更新的连续性。Inherit4Rec-D2S通过共同激活……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Inherit4Rec参数继承框架，同时支持稠密到稠密（D2D）扩展和稠密到稀疏（D2S）转换，无需从头重训即可在动态演化的推荐数据下高效扩展推荐模型容量并避免性能骤降。
en_tdlr: Inherit4Rec is a parameter-inheritance framework that supports both Dense-to-Dense (D2D) growth and Dense-to-Sparse (D2S) conversion, enabling efficient scaling of recommendation models under dynamically evolving data without costly retraining from scratch.
